mestizaje-redescubriendo-el-mundo-del-fl.fact: Priests and royal officials might have classified persons as mestizos, but individuals also used the term in self-identification.
It was a formal label for individuals in official documents, such as censuses, parish registers, Inquisition trials, and others.
Det var en formell beteckning för individer i officiella dokument, såsom folkräkningar, kyrkböcker, inkvisitionsrättegångar och andra.
The term was used as an ethno-racial exonym for mixed-race castas that evolved during the Spanish Empire.
In the modern era, mestizaje is used by scholars such as Gloria Anzaldúa as a synonym for miscegenation, with positive connotations.
The noun mestizaje, derived from the adjective mestizo, is a term for racial mixing that did not come into usage until the 20th century; it was not a colonial-era term.
Le terme était utilisé comme exonyme ethno-racial pour les castas métisses qui ont évolué pendant l'Empire espagnol.
Med Bourbon-reformerne og Amerikas uafhængighed forsvandt kastesystemet, og udtryk som "mestizo" blev mindre populært.
Mestizo, in the modern day, is a term used to describe people of mixed Spanish and Indigenous Americans descent in the Americas, with the term mestiza used for women, and mestizo used for men.
Prester og kongelige embetsmenn kan ha klassifisert personer som mestizos, men enkeltpersoner brukte også begrepet i egen selvidentifikasjon.

In the modern era, particularly in Latin America, mestizo has become more of a cultural term, with the term indio ('Indian') being reserved exclusively for people who have maintained a separate Indigenous ethnic and cultural identity, language, tribal affiliation, community engagement, etc.
Other definitions of the word would be used to describe any mixed-raced person living in Latin America, whether they are of African, European, or Indigenous ancestry.
In bestimmten Regionen des Kontinents kann es sich auch auf jeden beziehen, der kulturell hispanisch ist, unabhängig von der rassischen Mischung.
With the Bourbon reforms and the independence of the Americas, the caste system disappeared and terms like "mestizo" fell in popularity.
Otras definiciones de la palabra se usarían para describir a cualquier persona de raza mixta que viva en América Latina, ya sea de ascendencia africana, europea o indígena.
Mestizaje-substantiivi, joka on johdettu adjektiivista mestizo, on termi rodulliselle sekoittumiselle, ja se ei tullut käyttöön ennen 1900-lukua; se ei ollut siirtomaa-ajan termi.
In certain regions of the continent, it may also refer to anyone who is culturally Hispanic, regardless of racial admixture.

diego-amador-amp-amp-jose-maria-bandera.fact: Desde un principio hizo algo muy inusual con el instrumento: aplicó su conocimiento de flamenco al tocarlo.​ Al ser parte de una comunidad gitana, su familia y vecinos comulgaban música a campo abierto.

I tenårene sine grunnla Raimundo og Rafael, to av hans eldre brødre, flamencogruppen Pata Negra, kjent på 80-tallet for sine fusjoner av flamenco, rock og blues, der Diego spilte trommer sporadisk.

En su adolescencia, Raimundo y Rafael, dos de sus hermanos mayores, fundaron el grupo flamenco Pata Negra,​ famoso en los '80 por sus fusiones de flamenco, rock y blues, donde Diego tocaba batería esporádicamente.

La banda fue fundada en 1979 en Arles, Francia, y sus miembros son de herencia romaní catalana (gitano).
De indspillede en spansksproglig flamenco-version af "You've Got a Friend in Me" til 2010-filmen "Toy Story 3.
Their 2013 album "Savor Flamenco" won the Grammy Award for Best World Music Album in 2014.

The Gipsy Kings brought rumba flamenca to a global audience; their 1987 self-titled album, featuring "Bamboleo" and "Djobi Djoba," spent 40 weeks on the US charts, a rare feat for a Spanish-language record.
Deres flamencoinspirerte cover av Eagles' «Hotel California» ble omtalt i 1998-filmen «The Big Lebowski».

binomio-de-oro.fact: He was able to maintain the group's popularity by hiring young talents and maintaining always a new style.
Romero avait connu le succès avec les chansons à succès « Amanecemos Parrandeando » et « Digan lo que digan ».

Romero first hired Gabriel "El Gaby" García who was physically very similar to Orozco and impersonated him, the chorus was Jean Carlos Centeno and the other was Richard Salcedo, as well as his accordionist nephew JF "El Morre" Romero.
Binomio de Oro then recorded the first album without Orozco titled "Todo Corazón (album)" featuring Romero siting along an empty chair implying that his partner was irreplaceable.
Tanto Orozco como Romero eran estudiantes que asistían a clases universitarias en la ciudad de Barranquilla.
After the assassination of Orozco, Romero took the group under his management.
Binomio de Oro de América is a Colombian Vallenato group that was founded by lead singer Rafael Orozco and accordionist Israel Romero in the Caribbean Region of Colombia on June 16, 1976.
Han formåede at opretholde gruppens popularitet ved at ansætte unge talenter og altid holde en ny stil ved lige.
Both Orozco and Romero were students attending university classes in the city of Barranquilla.
Romero had been successful with the hit songs "Amanecemos Parrandeando" and "Digan lo que digan".
Their debut was in Venezuela in a national popular TV show contest "Premio Orquidea" which they won that year.
The group recorded the long play "Binomio de Oro (album)" in 1977. == After Orozco == After the assassination of Orozco, Romero took the group under his management.
Orozco hade precis spelat in låtarna "Cariñito de mi vida" av Diomedes Diaz, "Presentimiento" och "Adelante".

Romero palkkasi ensin Gabriel "El Gaby" Garcían, joka muistutti fyysisesti hyvin paljon Orozcoa ja esiintyi tämän nimissä, kuorossa oli Jean Carlos Centeno ja toinen oli Richard Salcedo, sekä hänen haitaristinsa, veljenpoika JF "El Morre" Romero.

Romero hatte gerade eine Long Play mit dem Sänger Emilio Oviedo aufgenommen, mit starken Einflüssen von Sänger Jorge Oñate, den Brüdern Lopez, dem Akkordeonisten Colacho Mendoza und Los Hermanos Zuleta, die zu dieser Zeit die führenden Vallenato-Gruppen waren.
Gruppen spilte inn langspekkeren «Binomio de Oro (album)» i 1977. == Etter Orozco == Etter attentatet på Orozco tok Romero gruppen under sin ledelse.
Orozco had just recorded the songs "Cariñito de mi vida" by Diomedes Diaz, "Presentimiento" and "Adelante".
The group grew up in popularity in the 1980s and 1990s and developed mainstream popularity in Venezuela, especially in the city of Maracaibo and in Mexico, mainly in the city of Monterrey.

Romero had just recorded a Long Play with singer Emilio Oviedo, with strong influences from singer Jorge Oñate, the Lopez brothers, accordionist Colacho Mendoza and the Los Hermanos Zuleta who were the mainstream vallenato groups at the moment.
The group recorded the long play "Binomio de Oro (album)" in 1977.

alvaro-de-luna.fact: As a child he played local concerts covering songs by the Spanish band Jarabe de Palo, which he cites as a major influence.
He was born in Seville on 28 September 1994 and began singing his own songs with a guitar before he was ten years old.
Med Sinsinati klatrede hans sange "Indios y vaqueros" og "Cuando éramos dos" til toppen af Canal Fiesta Radios Top 50.
Hänen ensimmäinen sooloalbuminsa, "Levantaremos al sol," julkaistiin vuonna 2022 ja kokosi yhteen hänen varhaiset soolosinglensä.
His debut solo album, "Levantaremos al sol," was released in 2022 and gathered together his early solo singles.
Antes de iniciar su carrera en solitario, fue el cantante principal y compositor del grupo de pop español Sinsinati de 2017 a 2020.
Han föddes i Seville den 28 september 1994 och började sjunga sina egna låtar med gitarr innan han fyllde tio år.
Som barn spilte han lokale konserter der han fremførte sanger av det spanske bandet Jarabe de Palo, som han trekker frem som en stor innflytelse.
With Sinsinati, his songs "Indios y vaqueros" and "Cuando éramos dos" climbed to the top of Canal Fiesta Radio's Top 50.
Il s'est associé à deux des plus grandes stars d'Espagne, Pablo Alborán et Aitana, sur la chanson de 2021 « Llueve sobre mojado ».
Er wird aufgrund seiner unverwechselbar rauen Stimme oft „El Cantante de la Voz Rota" (Der Sänger mit der gebrochenen Stimme) genannt.
He plays pop rock and is a self-taught guitarist who has written and composed his own material since childhood.
He recorded the duet "Mañana" with Spanish pop star Lola Indigo.
Before going solo, he was the lead singer and songwriter of the Spanish pop band Sinsinati from 2017 to 2020.
His breakout solo single "Juramento eterno de sal" (2020) became a trend on Spotify and launched his solo career.
He teamed up with two of Spain's biggest stars, Pablo Alborán and Aitana, on the 2021 song "Llueve sobre mojado."
He is often nicknamed "El Cantante de la Voz Rota" (The Singer with the Broken Voice) for his distinctive raspy vocals.

so-perfect-en-concierto.fact: La chanson a atteint la première place en Australie, en Nouvelle-Zélande, en Irlande et au Royaume-Uni.
The song also won "Song of the Year" at the ARIA Music Awards in 2014.
"She Looks So Perfect" is a song and extended play by Australian pop rock band 5 Seconds of Summer, taken from their self-titled debut album (2014).
Ed Sheeran coverede sangen på Capital FM. == Baggrund == "She Looks So Perfect" er blevet beskrevet som pop punk, power pop og pop rock.
Ed Sheeran covered the song on Capital FM. == Background == "She Looks So Perfect" has been described as pop punk, power pop and pop rock.
The Wire wrote that the song sounds as if it were purposely crafted as power pop to appeal to fans of a boy band, but an "infinitesimally edgier" boy band than One Direction.
Sangen vant også "Song of the Year" under ARIA Music Awards i 2014.
The song was digitally released in Australia on 23 February 2014 and in Europe on 23 March 2014 through Capitol Records and Hi or Hey Records, as their debut single with a major record label.
It's the age-old tale of a forbidden romantic runaway; trouble is, with this anthem poised to scale the chart, slipping away unnoticed will soon prove slightly more difficult.
The song peaked at number one in Australia, New Zealand, Ireland and the United Kingdom.
The accompanying music video was released on 24 February 2014.
It was certified 8× platinum by the Australian Recording Industry Association for selling 560,000 equivalent units.

El tema se lanzó digitalmente en Australia el 23 de febrero de 2014 y en Europa el 23 de marzo de 2014 a través de Capitol Records y Hi or Hey Records, como su sencillo debut con una discográfica importante.
8 gånger platina av Australian Recording Industry Association för att ha sålt 560 000 enheter (equivalent units).
It was written by band members Michael Clifford and Ashton Irwin along with Jake Sinclair, who also produced the song, with additional production by Eric Valentine.
Der dazugehörige Musikvideo wurde am 24. Februar 2014 veröffentlicht.
Se on kirjoittanut yhtyeen jäsenet Michael Clifford ja Ashton Irwin yhdessä Jake Sinclairin kanssa, joka myös tuotti kappaleen, ja lisätuotannosta vastasi Eric Valentine.

nebulossa.fact: In 2023, they released their song, "Me ha dado porno".
On 3 February 2024, the duo won the Benidorm Fest 2024 with the song "Zorra", earning the right to represent Spain in the Eurovision Song Contest 2024, where they finished in 22nd place.
Das doppelte S ist eine symbolische Anspielung auf die katalanische Sprache, in der viele Wörter diese Schreibweise verwenden.
The double S is a symbolic reference to the Catalan language, where many words use this spelling.
Nebulossa then participated on 9 May at the Malmö Arena in the second semi-final, joined by Ana Villa who played percussion with luminous drumsticks.
Följande år, 2021, presenterade de sitt första studioalbum, "Poliédrica de mí", där de inkluderade låten "Glam", som valdes till Årets bästa låt 2021 av Indie Cool-gemenskapen.
Nebulossa competed in Benidorm Fest 2024, the Spanish selection for the Eurovision Song Contest 2024, with the song "Zorra".
In 2020, Nebulossa presented their first single "La Colmena".
I 2023 ga de ut sangen «Me ha dado porno».
En 2020, Nebulossa a présenté leur premier single "La Colmena".
The name of the group alludes to nebulae (nebulosa in Spanish and in Portuguese ) because on a trip to Port Ainé they went to an astronomical observatory where they constantly mentioned them.
Nebulossa konkurrerede i Benidorm Fest 2024, den spanske udvælgelse til Eurovision Song Contest 2024, med sangen "Zorra".
The following year, in 2021, they presented their first studio album, "Poliédrica de mí", where they included the song "Glam", which was chosen as Best Song of 2021 by the Indie Cool community.

Nebulossa (Spanish pronunciation: [neβuˈlosa]) is a Spanish electropop duo from Ondara, consisting of singer María "Mery" Bas (born 29 December 1967) and keyboardist and producer Mark Dasousa (born 5 May 1975).
El nombre del grupo alude a las nebulosas porque en un viaje a Port Ainé fueron a un observatorio astronómico donde las mencionaban constantemente.
He sijoittuivat ensimmäiseksi puolivälierässään 30. tammikuuta 2024, jolloin he selviytyivät Festin finaaliin, jonka he voittivat.
They placed first in their semi-final on 30 January 2024, qualifying for the final of the Fest, which they won.

carmen-linares.fact: Carmen Linares hat sich einen festen Platz in der zeitgenössischen spanischen Musikkultur erarbeitet.
Her professional career began in the dance company of Carmen Mora, and she made her first recording in 1971.
In 2022 she received the Princess of Asturias Award in the category "Arts".
She became a prominent figure in the genre of world music and critically acclaimed in flamenco music.
Ella pertenece a una generación de artistas flamencos junto a Paco de Lucía, Camarón, Enrique Morente, Jose Mercé, Manolo Sanlúcar y Tomatito, y está considerada una leyenda del flamenco.
Carmen Linares has carved out a place for herself in contemporary Spanish musical culture.
She is also recognized as a maestra for young generation like Miguel Poveda, Estrella Morente, Pitingo, and Arcangel.
She was awarded Spain's Premio Nacional de Música for interpretation in 2001.
Hun anerkjennes også som en maestra for den yngre generasjonen, som Miguel Poveda, Estrella Morente, Pitingo og Arcangel.
1970- ja 1980-luvuilla hän työskenteli Madridissa yhdessä sellaisten artistien kuin Enrique Morente, Camarón, Carmen Mora sekä veljesten Juan ja Pepe Habichuela kanssa.
Hennes professionella karriär inleddes i Carmen Moras dansensemble, och hon gjorde sin första inspelning 1971.

In the 90’s Carmen Linares performed Manuel de Falla’s El Amor Brujo, under conductors such as Josep Pons, Leo Brower, Rafael Frübech de Burgos and Victor Pablo in venues including the Lincoln Center in New York, the Sydney Opera House, and the Royal Albert Hall in London.
Elle a reçu le Premio Nacional de Música espagnol pour l'interprétation en 2001.
She belongs a generation of flamenco artists along with Paco de Lucía, Camarón, Enrique Morente, Jose Mercé, Manolo Sanlúcar and Tomatito and she is considered a flamenco legend.
Carmen Pacheco Rodríguez, better known by her stage name Carmen Linares, is a Spanish flamenco singer.

Hun blev en fremtrædende skikkelse inden for worldmusic og roste kritikerne højt inden for flamencomusik. Correction — fixing the second clause for natural, faithful Danish: Hun blev en fremtrædende skikkelse inden for genren worldmusic og er kritikerrost inden for flamencomusik.
In the 70s and 80s she worked in Madrid alongside artists such as Enrique Morente, Camarón, Carmen Mora, and the brothers Juan and Pepe Habichuela.

damian-cordoba.fact: He won the 2014 Premio Gardel for Best Male Cuarteto Album for his 2013 record "Sensacional."
Comenzó su carrera en 2000 con apenas 13 años, uniéndose al grupo de cuarteto Los Bingos tras la partida de Walter Olmos para seguir una carrera en solitario.
Molemmat hänen vuoden 2010 albumeistaan, "Feroz" ja "Una Pasión", saivat kultasertifikaatin Argentiinassa.
Im Jahr 2001, im Alter von 14 Jahren, war er das Vorprogramm für Walter Olmos im Luna Park Stadion in Buenos Aires.
He is widely known by the nickname "El Wacho."
He began his career in 2000 at just 13, joining the cuarteto group Los Bingos after Walter Olmos left to go solo.
In 2001, aged 14, he was the support act for Walter Olmos at Buenos Aires's Luna Park stadium.
In 2025 he was a guest artist on La K'onga's live recording at Estadio Vélez.
Han er bredt kendt under øgenavnet "El Wacho.
Il a sorti son premier album solo « Como Una Puñalada » en 2003, ce qui lui a valu un contrat avec Leader Music.
He released his debut solo album "Como Una Puñalada" in 2003, earning a deal with Leader Music.
Damián Córdoba, full name Damián Jacinto Córdoba, was born in 1987 in Catamarca, Argentina.
Both of his 2010 albums, "Feroz" and "Una Pasión," were certified Gold in Argentina.
I 2006 spilte han inn sitt første livealbum på Estadio Super Deportivo i Córdoba, hjembyen til cuarteto.
Han vann 2014 Premio Gardel för Bästa Manliga Cuarteto-album för sin 2013-skiva "Sensacional.
In 2006 he recorded his first live album at the Estadio Super Deportivo in Córdoba, the birthplace of cuarteto.
His cuarteto song "Te mentiría" has racked up more than twelve million YouTube plays.

martin-sanchez-y-los-corazones-salvajes.fact: Enrique Martín Sánchez, better known as Quique Martín (Avilés, Spain, December 29, 1972) is a former Spanish footballer.
Quique Martín is Salamanca's all-time top scorer, with 71 goals. == Clubs == == Honors == === National championships === == References ==
He retired at age 38 after not renewing his contract with Salamanca, at the end of the 2010-2011 season.
Hän jäi eläkkeelle 38-vuotiaana, kun hän ei uusinut sopimustaan Salamancan kanssa kauden 2010-2011 päätteeksi.
I sommeren 2008, ved 35 års alder, fornyet han for én sesong til med opsjon på en til med den charro-klubben. Ved slutten av sesongen 2009/10 fornyet han for én sesong til.
In the summer of 2008, at age 35, he renewed for one more season with an option for a second with the charro club. At the end of the 2009/10 season he renewed for one more season.
In his last season he got injured, being out for several months.
Su posición en el campo era generalmente mediocampista ofensivo, aunque también podía jugar en el ala izquierda.
Hinter den Kulissen auch nicht als klassischer Angreifer eingesetzt, stach er durch seine Torgefahr hervor und ist zudem ein Experte für Standardsituationen.
In 2011 the book Quique Martín, historia viva de la Unión was published, written by authors Roberto Benito González and Adrián Rodríguez Losada, which reviews the career and life of the Asturian.

« Cependant, Quique Martín se distingue en étant le joueur avec le plus de matchs en Segunda División (425 à la fin de la saison 2010-11), dont plus de 200 avec l'UD Salamanca sur six saisons non consécutives. »
During the 2007-08 season he was also his team's top scorer with 14 goals.
Under 2007–08-säsongen var han också sitt lags främsta målskytt med 14 mål.
I hans sidste sæson blev han skadet og var ude i flere måneder.
Despite not being a pure forward, he stood out for his goal-scoring ability and is also an expert at set pieces.

However, Quique Martín stands out for being the player with the most matches in Segunda División (425 at the end of the 2010-11 season), of which he played more than 200 with UD Salamanca over six non-consecutive seasons.
His position on the field was usually attacking midfielder, although he could also play on the left wing.

orquesta-filarmonica-de-malaga-jose-carr.fact: Orkestern har gästats av en framstående skara gästdirigenter, däribland Jesús López Cobos, Philippe Entremont, Juanjo Mena, Sergiu Comissiona, Rafael Frühbeck de Burgos, Antoni Ros-Marbà, Nicholas Milton och Yoav Talmi, för att bara nämna några få.

The orchestra has received soloists, including Alicia de Larrocha, Plácido Domingo, Alfredo Kraus, Joaquín Achúcarro, Pinchas Zukerman, Montserrat Caballé, Ainhoa Arteta, Carlos Álvarez, Stefan Dohr, Hansjörg Schellenberger, Leonidas Kavakos, Nikolaj Znaider, Julian Rachlin, and Asier Polo.

The orchestra has hosted a distinguished roster of guest conductors, including Jesús López Cobos, Philippe Entremont, Juanjo Mena, Sergiu Comissiona, Rafael Frühbeck de Burgos, Antoni Ros-Marbà, Nicholas Milton, and Yoav Talmi to name but a few.
They have performed at several theaters and festivals throughout Spain, as well as touring Europe, including Sweden, Greece, Slovakia, Czech Republic and Germany.
Den Málaga Filharmoniske Orkester har udgivet flere cd-indspilninger som en del af Festival of Ancient Music og Cycle of Contemporary Music-arrangementerne.
He ovat esiintyneet useissa teattereissa ja festivaaleilla ympäri Espanjaa sekä kiertäneet Eurooppaa, mukaan lukien Ruotsi, Kreikka, Slovakia, Tšekki ja Saksa.

Orkesteret har hatt besøk av solister, blant dem Alicia de Larrocha, Plácido Domingo, Alfredo Kraus, Joaquín Achúcarro, Pinchas Zukerman, Montserrat Caballé, Ainhoa Arteta, Carlos Álvarez, Stefan Dohr, Hansjörg Schellenberger, Leonidas Kavakos, Nikolaj Znaider, Julian Rachlin og Asier Polo.
The Málaga Philharmonic Orchestra has issued several CD recordings as a part of the Festival of Ancient Music and Cycle of Contemporary Music events.
Seit 2014 ist Manuel Hernández-Silva ihr Chefdirigent. == Geschichte == Das Philharmonische Orchester Málaga (Orquesta Filarmónica de Málaga) gab sein Eröffnungskonzert am 14. Februar 1991.

La mairie de Málaga et le Gouvernement régional d'Andalousie ont collaboré pour créer l'Orquesta Ciudad de Málaga (Orchestre municipal de Málaga), traduisant la conviction que Málaga méritait son propre orchestre symphonique.

The Málaga Town Council and the Regional Government of Andalusia collaborated to establish the Orquesta Ciudad de Málaga (City Orchestra of Málaga), reflecting the belief that Málaga deserved its own symphony orchestra.
Fundada en 1991, la Philharmonic toca regularmente en el Teatro Cervantes de Málaga.
Founded in 1991, the Philharmonic plays regularly at the Teatro Cervantes in Málaga.
The Málaga Philharmonic Orchestra (Spanish: Orquesta Filarmónica de Málaga 'OFM') is a Spanish orchestra based in Málaga.

Octav Calleya (1991–1995) Odón Alonso (1995–1999) Alexander Rahbari (1999–2004) Aldo Ceccato (2004–2009) Edmon Colomer (2010–2013) Manuel Hernández-Silva (2014– ) Official website Teatro Cervantes Official website
Since 2014, its principal conductor has been Manuel Hernández-Silva. == History == The Málaga Philharmonic Orchestra (Orquesta Filarmónica de Málaga) held its inaugural concert on 14 February 1991.

la-plazuela.fact: La Plazuela is a musical duo from Granada, Spain.

The name La Plazuela comes from "La Plazuela Techa" (the little roofed plaza) - a spare room in bandmate El Nitro's apartment building where friends gathered to jam, which became their improvised studio and hangout spot.
Their first EP, "Yunque, Clavos y Alcayatas," was released in 2019.
Formed in 2019, the duo's sound is a fusion of flamenco, funk, pop and electronic music.
Deres debutalbum, "Roneo Funk Club" (2023), blev udgivet på Universal Music Spain og co-produceret af Juanito Makande.
Their flamenco side draws on the genre's early greats, including Camaron, Enrique Morente, Pata Negra and Ketama.
À l'adolescence (vers 16 ans), ils ont commencé par reprendre des artistes admirés tels que Manzanita, Los Chichos et Pata Negra.
They became closer friends at 13 but it would be at 16 when they began to create covers of artists they admired, like Manzanita, Los Chichos, or Pata Negra.
Gegründet im Jahr 2019, ist der Klang des Duos eine Fusion aus Flamenco, Funk, Pop und elektronischer Musik.
As teenagers (around age 16), they started out making covers of admired artists such as Manzanita, Los Chichos and Pata Negra.
Heidän ensimmäinen EP-levynsä, "Yunque, Clavos y Alcayatas," julkaistiin vuonna 2019.
Their funk influences include modern acts like Silk Sonic, Jungle and Free Nationals.
Deras flamenco-sida hämtar inspiration från genrens tidiga storheter, däribland Camaron, Enrique Morente, Pata Negra och Ketama.
The Granada duo - Manuel Hidalgo Sierra ("El Indio") and Luis Abril Martin ("El Nitro") - first met as three-year-olds in the same class.
El dúo granadino - Manuel Hidalgo Sierra ("El Indio") y Luis Abril Martin ("El Nitro") - se conoció por primera vez con tres años en la misma clase.
Deres funk-påvirkninger inkluderer moderne artister som Silk Sonic, Jungle og Free Nationals.
Their debut studio album, "Roneo Funk Club" (2023), was released on Universal Music Spain and co-produced by Juanito Makande.

premios-juventud.fact: Pääsarjapalkinto, jonka mieslaulaja on voittanut useimmin, kuuluu Bad Bunnylle 23 Premios Juventud -palkinnolla.
With the 2019 edition, the show moved back to a Thursday and nominees and voting returned. == Records == === Most wins === The record for most Premios Juventud won is held by Karol G with 33 awards.

Med udgaven i 2019 flyttede showet tilbage til en torsdag, og nominerede og afstemning vendte tilbage. == Rekorder == === Flest sejre === Rekorden for flest vundne Premios Juventud indehaves af Karol G med 33 priser.
From 2004 to 2017 the show aired on a Thursday.

The records for most wins for a professional sports team belongs to the New York Yankees, with 8 awards. === Most wins in a single ceremony === The record for the most Premios Juventud won in a single year is held by Luis Fonsi (in 2009), with 10 awards won.
Från 2004 till 2017 sändes programmet på torsdagar.
Los ganadores se determinan mediante votación en línea en univision.com.
Premios Juventud is an awards show for Spanish-speaking celebrities in the areas of film, music, sports, fashion, and pop culture, presented by the television network Univision.
The record for most wins for a group belongs to RBD, who have collected 20 awards.
The record for most Premios Juventud won by a male artist belongs to Bad Bunny with 23 awards.

Past winners have included people such as Ricky Martin, Shakira, Prince Royce, Juanes, Enrique Iglesias, Daddy Yankee, Thalía, RBD, Romeo Santos, Antonio Banderas, Maná, Jennifer Lopez, Gloria Trevi and Fifth Harmony. == Editions == The first two editions were held in September.
Winners are determined by online vote at univision.com.

Premios Juventud zeichnet sich durch seine einzigartigen Kategorien aus, darunter „Me muero sin ese CD" (Album, ohne das ich nicht leben kann), „Mi concierto favorito" (Mein Lieblingskonzert) und „La más pegajosa" (Eingängigster Song).

Premios Juventud is set apart by their unique categories, including "Me muero sin ese CD" (Album I can't live without), "Mi concierto favorito" (My favorite concert), and "La más pegajosa" (Catchiest song).

Les anciens lauréats incluent notamment Ricky Martin, Shakira, Prince Royce, Juanes, Enrique Iglesias, Daddy Yankee, Thalía, RBD, Romeo Santos, Antonio Banderas, Maná, Jennifer Lopez, Gloria Trevi et Fifth Harmony. == Éditions == Les deux premières éditions se sont tenues en septembre.
The 2018 edition has been the only edition to be held on a Sunday and to not have nominees and voting.
Det er 2018-utgaven som er den eneste utgaven som har blitt arrangert på en søndag og uten nominerte og avstemning.

los-caracoles.fact: Construction began in 2004 and the dam and power station were completed in 2009. == See also == == References ==
Den 136 meter (446 fod) høje dæmning forsyner et kraftværk på 126 megawatt (169.000 hk) og sammen med Punta Negra-dæmningen nedstrøms sørger den for vanding af 15.000 hektar (37.000 acres).
The purpose of the dam is to provide water for irrigation and the generation of hydroelectric power.

Die 136 Meter (446 ft) hohe Staumauer versorgt ein Kraftwerk mit 126 Megawatt (169.000 PS) und sorgt zusammen mit dem flussabwärts gelegenen Punta Negra Dam für die Bewässerung von 15.000 Hektar (37.000 acres).
Dammens formål er å tilby vann til irrigasjon og produksjon av vannkraft.
El propósito de la presa es proporcionar agua para riego y la generación de energía hidroeléctrica.
La construction a commencé en 2004 et le barrage et la centrale électrique ont été achevés en 2009. == Voir aussi == == Références ==
Rakentaminen alkoi vuonna 2004, ja pato ja voimalaitos valmistuivat vuonna 2009. == Katso myös == == Lähteet ==
Lost Caracoles Dam, eller Caracoles Dam, är en fyllningsdamm med betongklädd front på floden San Juan, omkring 44 kilometer (27 mi) väster om San Juan i provinsen San Juan, Argentina.
The Lost Caracoles Dam, or Caracoles Dam is a concrete-face rock-fill dam on the San Juan River about 44 kilometres (27 mi) west of San Juan in San Juan Province, Argentina.
The 136-metre (446 ft) tall dam supports a 126 megawatts (169,000 hp) power station and together with the Punta Negra Dam downstream, it provides for the irrigation of 15,000 hectares (37,000 acres).

nu-metal-dance-revolution.fact: Its popularity continued through the early 2000s, with bands such as Papa Roach, Staind, and P.O.D. all selling multi-platinum albums.
Pantera, Helmet og Faith No More var med til at forme nu metal med deres groove metal- og alternative metal-stilarter i slutningen af 1980'erne og begyndelsen af 1990'erne.
Nu metal is one of the key genres of the new wave of American heavy metal.

Nu metal (sometimes stylized as nü-metal, with a metal umlaut) is a subgenre of alternative metal that combines elements of heavy metal music with elements of other music genres such as hip-hop, funk, industrial, and grunge.
Korn tunnetaan usein tämän alalajin uranuurtajana 1990-luvun puolivälistä, jolloin he julkaisivat nimeään kantavan debyyttialbuminsa.
Vocal styles are often rhythmic and influenced by hip-hop, and include singing, rapping, screaming and sometimes growling.
El nu metal rara vez incluye solos de guitarra u otras muestras de técnica musical, y enfatiza el ritmo con una instrumentación fuertemente sincopada.
Nu metal became popular in the late 1990s, with bands and artists such as Korn, Limp Bizkit, and Slipknot all releasing albums that sold millions of copies.
DJs medverkar ibland för att bidra med instrumentering såsom sampling, skivtallriksscratching och elektronisk bakgrundsmusik.
Les styles vocaux sont souvent rythmiques et influencés par le hip-hop, et incluent le chant, le rap, les cris et parfois le growl.
Korn is often credited as pioneering the subgenre in the mid-1990s with their self-titled debut album.
Nu metal rarely features guitar solos or other displays of musical technique and emphasizes rhythm with instrumentation that is heavily syncopated.
DJs are occasionally featured to provide instrumentation such as sampling, turntable scratching and electronic background music.
In the late 1980s and early 1990s, bands like Pantera, Helmet, and Faith No More were influential in the development of nu metal with their groove metal and alternative metal styles.
Nu-Metal-Gitarristen verwenden oft siebensaitige Gitarren, die tiefer gestimmt werden, um einen härteren Klang zu erzeugen.
Nu metal er en av de sentrale genrene innenfor den nye bølgen av amerikansk heavy metal.
Nu metal guitarists often use seven-string guitars that are down-tuned to produce a heavier sound.

el-kuelgue.fact: El Kuelgue är en argentinsk musikgrupp bildad år 2004.
Ils citent Illya Kuryaki and the Valderramas parmi leurs principales influences. En 2022, le chanteur du groupe, Julián Kartún, a souligné que le groupe s'essaie à différents genres pour s'amuser.
El Kuelgue er en argentinsk musikgruppe dannet i 2004.
Yksi heidän tärkeimmistä vaikutteistaan on Illya Kuryaki and the Valderramas. Vuonna 2022 yhtyeen laulaja Julián Kartún korosti, että yhtye tekee retkiä eri musiikkilajeihin huvin vuoksi.
Den heter Illya Kuryaki and the Valderramas som en av sine viktigste innflytelser. I 2022 bemerket bandets vokalist Julián Kartún at bandet utforsker forskjellige genre for å underholde seg selv.
El Kuelgue es una banda argentina formada en 2004.
Die Sprache der Quelle ist Spanisch, die Übersetzung lautet: El Kuelgue ist eine argentinische Musikgruppe, die 2004 gegründet wurde.
El Kuelgue es un grupo musical argentino formado en el año 2004.

Tienen como una de sus principales influencias a Illya Kuryaki and the Valderramas.​ En el año 2022, vocalista de la banda Julián Kartún remarcó que la banda hace incursión en diferentes géneros para divertirse.
El Kuelgue is an Argentine band formed in 2004.

pedro-pastor.fact: Nachdem er sein erstes Album veröffentlicht hatte, entschied er sich ein für alle Mal, sich der Musik zu widmen, und er hat bis heute weiterproduziert und produziert immer noch.
This work is made up of eleven tracks of shared authorship (except El tiempo, which is after Fernando Cabrera), and it was recorded live at the Museu Bar L'Oncle Jack in Barcelona.

In a family environment that instilled in him a love of music, he came into contact with different instruments: he started with piano lessons, but gave them up at age 12, and that's when he began playing the guitar, an instrument he felt drawn to from the very beginning.

He currently has seven full albums published, along with numerous singles, and performs concerts and tours both solo and together with Los Locos Descalzos, in Spain and in various countries across Latin America.

Han är en aktiv artist, både inom livemusik och på sociala medier, som han använder för att sprida sin musik, sitt budskap och sina idéer. == Karriär == 2012 släpptes EP:n med titeln Aunque esté mal contarlo, inspelad i ett akustiskt format med sång, gitarr, bas och violin.
The track Desnudémonos appears as the first single from this work.
Verket består av seks sosialt engasjerte og kritiske sanger som viser låtskriverens nonkonforme sinn.
The album was presented in October of that same year at the Sala Galileo Galilei in Madrid.

Il a actuellement sept albums complets publiés, ainsi que de nombreux singles, et donne des concerts et des tournées en solo et avec Los Locos Descalzos, en Espagne et dans divers pays d'Amérique latine.

Tällä teoksella hän kiersi Espanjaa ja Latinalaista Amerikkaa. Vuonna 2016 hän julkaisi albumin Solo los locos viven la libertad yhteistyössä muusikon ja runoilijan Suso Sudónin kanssa, jonka kanssa hän on tehnyt kaksi kiertuetta ja useita konsertteja.

He is an active artist, both in live music and on social media, which he uses to spread his music, his message, and his ideas. == Career == In 2012 the EP titled Aunque esté mal contarlo was released, recorded in an acoustic format with voice, guitar, bass, and violin.
The work consists of six socially committed and critical songs that show the nonconformist spirit of the singer-songwriter.

En un ambiente familiar que le inculcó el amor por la música, entró en contacto con diferentes instrumentos: comenzó con clases de piano, pero las abandonó a los 12 años, y fue entonces cuando empezó a tocar la guitarra, un instrumento por el que se sintió atraído desde el principio.

With this work he toured Spain and Latin America. In 2016 he released Solo los locos viven la libertad in collaboration with the musician and poet Suso Sudón, with whom he has shared two tours and several concerts.

His father is the well-known singer-songwriter Luis Pastor and his mother is Lourdes Guerra, also devoted to music and in turn the sister of the singer-songwriter Pedro Guerra. When Pedro Pastor was four years old, the family moved to Rivas-Vaciamadrid, where he spent his childhood.
After releasing his first album, he decided once and for all that he wanted to dedicate himself to music, and he has continued and still continues producing to this day.
Albummet blev præsenteret i oktober samme år på Sala Galileo Galilei i Madrid.

benzu.fact: It has a population of 1,987 according to the 2011 census, divided into two units with Ceuta as its municipality. == Description == Benzú is in the northwest of the Spanish exclave, with a northern coastline of the Mediterranean Sea.
Työkalut on valmistettu piikivistä, hiekkakivestä ja radiolariitista, ja kaapimia on käytetty sekä puun että nahan työstämiseen.
The different levels within the cave show the development of stone tools.
The tools are made from flint, sandstone and radiolarite with scrapers used for working both wood and hide.
Benzú is a small settlement within the Spanish autonomous city of Ceuta.
De forskellige niveauer i hulen viser udviklingen af stenredskaber.
The population was given as 1,127 in 2000 and it has risen to 1,170 in 2010.

Comparison of the technology used during the Pleistocene and Holocene periods by early humans shows that there was a very similar civilisation in caves excavated in Gibraltar, mainland Spain and around Tangier to caves around Benzú.
Researchers have found seven levels of human occupation dating back to 250,000 years ago.
Forskare har hittat sju nivåer av mänsklig bosättning som går tillbaka till för 250 000 år sedan.

Tiene una población de 1.987 habitantes según el censo de 2011, dividida en dos unidades con Ceuta como municipio. == Descripción == Benzú se encuentra en el noroeste del exclave español, con una costa norte del mar Mediterráneo.
The town has the last beach before the border and the small community of Belyounech in the Moroccan region of Tanger-Tetouan-Al Hoceima.
Bevisene de har funnet har fått dem til å se Gibraltarstredet ikke som en barriere, men som en bro for tidlige mennesker.
La ville possède la dernière plage avant la frontière et la petite communauté de Belyounech dans la région marocaine de Tanger-Tetouan-Al Hoceima.
The evidence they have found has led them to think of the Straits of Gibraltar not as a barrier but a bridge to early humans.
Die Kleinstadt hat etwa 1.200 Einwohner im Jahr 2011 und die Bevölkerungszahl ist im letzten Jahrzehnt nur leicht gestiegen.
The small town has about 1,200 inhabitants in 2011 and the population has risen only slightly in the last decade.

Magdalena Cullen (born August 8, 2000), known by her stage name Maggie Cullen, is an Argentine folk singer.

I Augusti 2023 släppte hon sitt debutalbum, Canciones del viento, ett album med 12 låtar utgivet av bolaget DBN Argentina, på vilket Nadia Larcher, León Gieco och gruppen Dos Más Uno medverkade som gäster.
Albumet vant Gardel Awards Gardel 2024 i kategorien Beste Folkloreartistalbum.

mocedades.fact: Tätä seurasi heidän toinen studioalbuminsa Mocedades 2, jälleen Calderónin tuottamana, julkaistiin vuonna 1970 ja sisälsi hittibiisin "Más allá" sekä Amaya Urangan version The Beatlesin klassikosta "Let It Be".
Eventually they decided to form a vocal group named Voces y Guitarras singing folk and spiritual music, with also music from The Beatles as their influences.

He took an immediate interest in the group and renamed them Mocedades, meaning youths (from the Spanish word mocedad).

The members of Voces y Guitarras were Amaya Uranga, Izaskun Uranga, Estibaliz Uranga, Roberto Uranga, Rafael Blanco, Sergio Blanco, José Ipiña, Javier Garay and Francisco "Paco" Panera.

The group was now on its way to making a remarkable string of hits, starting with "Eres tú".

Finalement, ils décidèrent de former un groupe vocal nommé Voces y Guitarras interprétant de la musique folk et spirituelle, avec également la musique des The Beatles comme influences.

He is the creator of "soulería," soul set to the rhythm of bulería.
He performed again at the same theater from November 30 to December 9, 2007, and then at the Teatro Bellas Artes in Madrid from December 10, 2007, to January 13, 2008.
Su padre era miembro de la Guardia Civil, y él creció en un cuartel. Aprendió cante dentro de la familia, ya que pertenece a uno de los grandes linajes cantaores, como las familias Valencia y Carpio.

Il travaillait à l'aéroport en portant des valises tout en chantant des bulerías et des fandangos de Manolo Caracol.

vetusta-morla.fact: El grupo era un proyecto de hobby para los participantes; el cantante principal Pucho se dedicaba al diseño gráfico, el baterista David "el Indio" ("the Indian") Garcia trabajaba como profesor, el guitarrista Juan Manuel Latorre tenía un programa en Radio 3, y el tecladista Jorge Gonzalez enseñaba física.
To solve the problem of lacking a label, they created their own, Pequeño Salto Mortal (Fatal Little Leap).
At the end of 2001, the new bass-player Alvaro Baglietto replaced Alejandro Notario and since then, the band's composition has not been changed.
Indieselskaber var angiveligt ikke tiltrukket af bandets kommercielle sound, og de store selskaber så ingen fremtid i deres musik.
Tilanne muuttui vuonna 2006, kun heidän esiintymisensä RTVE:n Radio 3 -konserteissa ja Espanjan edustajina Beirutin International Anti-Crisis Festivalilla toivat heille kansainvälisen rock-yleisön.

The situation changed in 2006, when their performances at RTVE's Radio 3 concerts and as representatives for Spain at the International Anti-Crisis Festival in Beirut, won them an international audience of rock fans.
Indie music labels were reportedly not attracted to the commercial sound of the band and large ones did not see prospects for their music.

Winner du Concurso de Rock de La Elipa en 2001, le groupe attire l'attention d'un producteur professionnel, David Hyam, qui a produit le premier EP du groupe, La Cuadratura Del Circulo, qui ne sera sorti qu'en 2003.

The band was a hobby project for the participants; lead singer Pucho was engaged in graphic design, drummer David "el Indio" ("the Indian") Garcia worked as a teacher, guitarist Juan Manuel Latorre had a program on Radio 3, and keyboardist Jorge Gonzalez taught physics.
Der erste Demo, "13 Horas Con Lucy" ("13 Hours With Lucy"), wurde 2000 veröffentlicht und gewann einige lokale Musikpreise.
For flere år forsøkte Vetusta Morla uten hell å finne et plateselskap.
The first demo, "13 Horas Con Lucy" ("13 Hours With Lucy"), was released in 2000 and won a few local music awards.
Vetusta Morla is a Spanish indie-rock band originally from the city of Tres Cantos located near Madrid, Spain.
Following this, the musicians decided to start working on the project seriously and quit their day jobs to fully devote themselves to music.

Winning the Concurso de Rock de La Elipa in 2001 brought them to the attention of a professional producer, David Hyam, who produced the band's first EP, La Cuadratura Del Circulo, which wasn't released until 2003.
I 2001, i slutet av året, ersatte den nya basisten Alvaro Baglietto Alejandro Notario, och sedan dess har bandets sammansättning inte ändrats.
For several years, Vetusta Morla tried unsuccessfully to find a label.

Marina Ann Hantzis (born 1988), known professionally as Sasha Grey, is an American actress, model, writer, musician, and former pornographic film actress.

rock-pop-legends.fact: Rock music is a genre of popular music that originated in the United States as "rock and roll" in the late 1940s and early 1950s, developing into a range of styles from the late 50s to mid-1960s, primarily in the United States and United Kingdom.
Rock also drew strongly from genres such as electric blues and folk, and incorporated influences from jazz and other styles.
Usually, rock is song-based music with a 44 time signature and using a verse–chorus form; however, the genre has become extremely diverse.
It has its roots beginning as classic rock and roll, a style that drew from the African-American musical genres of blues and rhythm and blues, as well as from country music.
Vanligtvis är rock sångbaserad musik med en 4/4-taktart och vers–refräng-form; genren har dock blivit extremt mångsidig.
Rock zog auch stark aus Genres wie Electric Blues und Folk und übernahm Einflüsse aus Jazz und anderen Stilen.
Rock is typically centered on the electric guitar, usually as part of a rock group with an electric bass guitar, drums, and one or more singers.
Like pop music, lyrics often stress romantic love but also address a wide variety of other themes that are frequently social or political.

Rock musicians in the mid-1960s began to advance the album ahead of the single as the dominant form of recorded music expression and consumption, with the Beatles at the forefront of this development.
Tiene sus raíces comenzando como classic rock and roll, un estilo que bebió de los géneros musicales afroamericanos del blues y el rhythm and blues, así como de la country music.

New genres that emerged included progressive rock, which extended artistic elements, heavy metal, which emphasized an aggressive thick sound, and glam rock, which highlighted showmanship and visual style.
Their contributions lent the genre a cultural legitimacy in the mainstream and initiated a rock-informed album era in the music industry for the next several decades.
Rock was the most popular genre of music in the U.S. and much of the western world from the 1960s up to the 2010s.
Rock-muusikot alkoivat 1960-luvun puolivälissä nostaa albumin singlen edelle äänitetyn musiikin hallitsevana ilmaisun ja kuluttamisen muotona, Beatles tämän kehityksen eturintamassa.
Le rock est généralement centré sur la guitare électrique, habituellement au sein d'un groupe de rock comprenant une basse électrique, une batterie et un ou plusieurs chanteurs.
Rock var den mest populære musikgenre i USA og store dele af den vestlige verden fra 1960'erne og frem til 2010'erne.
Som popmusikk handler tekster ofte om romantisk kjærlighet, men tar også opp et bredt spekter av andre temaer som ofte er sosiale eller politiske.

farruquito-en-concierto.fact: Con quince años de edad crea su primer espectáculo, Raíces Flamencas, donde se distingue a un bailaor de una nueva dimensión que acopla toda su tradición a una concepción artística personal prodigiosa.

jay-wheeler.fact: Il a d'abord développé un intérêt pour la musique dès son enfance en chantant dans son église locale, où il a également appris à jouer du piano.

Initially the band's main interest was in studio recording, but they also performed a few live gigs.
Initially, Daly and Lundon shared synthesiser duties on the group's albums, but Daly began taking on the majority of synthesiser/keyboard parts as the group's popularity continued to rise.

They then played with various Knowsley post-punk groups (including different line-ups of the band the Glass Torpedoes) before Daly and Lundon continued on their own.
